answers.core: I don't understand why 2D nodes are being rendered without a 2D camera contrarily to what happens with 3D nodes. There is sure a good design reason for it that I cannot understand but I could not find it or a workaround that works for what I'm trying to do. Thank you in advance.
answers.workaround:
I have not found any workaround besides just disabling the visibility of the 2D nodes as some people suggested in the forum. But I plan to make this game multiplayer and that would be incompatible with having one player in the 2D world and the other in the 3D one at the same time.
Edit: The camera can be moved where it has nothing to render as @Calinou pointed.

title: Do not render 2D nodes when there is no 2D camera present
